title: Medical Face Masks — Specification
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Ministry of Health and Family Welfare (MoHFW)

clauses.title: Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE) Classes
clauses.text: Clause 5.1 & Table 1 (Performance Requirements of Surgical Masks): (1) Class 1 Masks: Bacterial Filtration Efficiency (BFE) >= 95.0%, Differential pressure (breathability) < 29.4 Pa/cm². (2) Class 2 Masks: BFE >= 98.0%, Differential pressure < 29.4 Pa/cm². (3) Class 3 Masks (Fluid Resistant): BFE >= 98.0%, Differential pressure < 49.0 Pa/cm², Splash resistance to synthetic blood at 120 mmHg (16.0 kPa).

clauses.title: Microbial Cleanliness (Bioburden) and Biocompatibility
clauses.text: Clause 5.3 & IS 16289 (Bioburden and Biocompatibility): Total viable microbial bioburden of the mask shall not exceed 30 CFU/g of mask material. Materials in contact with wearer skin shall show zero skin irritation and zero cytotoxicity under ISO 10993.
